admission.scope: uniform arrays plus eight scalar bytes and explicit code/SDK reserve; actual ELF gate required, stack unmeasured

collective_model.scope: compact reference model; selected transport census is demand_model.selective_protocol

demand_model.column_link_scope: sum of both directions on each physical column link; not a directed-link peak; assumes full-column chain broadcast
demand_model.decision: retain full panels for dense pairs; choose device comparison only where partial demand pays for indexing/packing
demand_model.limitation: column-wide traversal and callback count remain; headers, dispatch, pack latency, code, SDK state, stack and contention excluded
demand_model.packing_rule: full-demand pairs use the original panel without copying; partial pairs copy from completed row replicas
demand_model.scope: host analytic payload/storage only; no SDK calls, cycles or speedup

selective_protocol.scope: DATA and ACK include SDK route words; RELEASE/init count collective payload only; control latency and physical contention unmeasured

metadata.communication_scope: analytic chain-collective payload, including padded lanes/vertices; independent of pruning at fixed owner map, not measured cycles
metadata.declared_bytes_excludes: code, collective library state, alignment, stack; not SRAM admission
metadata.delivery_count_scope: selective descriptor model only; excludes local fanout and ingress, not executed by full-panel kernel
metadata.input_contract: finite FP32 X, coefficients and weights; FP64 scatter reference

scope: One complete sparse-input GCN forward pass: Ahat ReLU(Ahat X W0) W1, H16/O7. Cora uses every native1433 feature and the retained unpruned seed11 final200epoch checkpoint.
